idea-plugin.name: Cfml Extra Completion
idea-plugin.description:
Cfml Extra Completion fills gaps in the bundled CFML plugin's code completion. The built-in completion only sees symbols declared in the current file; this plugin adds the project-wide symbols it misses, and stops flagging them as "unresolved". Suggestions are added on top of the built-in CFML completion — nothing is removed or replaced.

What it adds

  • Variables and functions declared in the nearest Application.cfm, offered in every page under that directory.
  • application.* and this.* scope symbols set in the nearest Application.cfc (e.g. from onApplicationStart).
  • Variables and functions from files pulled in via cfinclude / script include in the current file (followed recursively, cycle-safe).

It also suppresses the CFML "unresolved reference" warning for exactly these symbols, so the wavy underline disappears for things that really do exist — while genuinely unknown identifiers stay flagged.

Optional features (off by default, under Settings | Other Settings | Cfml Extra Completion)

  • Resolve ColdFusion mappings (this.mappings) when following cfinclude.
  • Merge Application.cfm / Application.cfc from all ancestor directories, not just the nearest one.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate with the CFML plugin installed and enabled (this plugin builds on it).
